## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(car)
library(forestplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsci)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

```

## READ IN DATA

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## SES+Behavior Results
adjusted_mrural_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/ChildRural_M3_AA_Summary20260607.xlsx")
adjusted_gmrural_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/ChildRural_M3_GM_Summary20260607.xlsx")
adjusted_mschlyrs_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/SCHLYRS_M3_AA_Summary20260607.xlsx")
adjusted_gmschlyrs_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/SCHLYRS_M3_GM_Summary20260607.xlsx")
adjusted_mlivegpar_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/LIVEGPAR_M3_AA_Summary20260607.xlsx")
adjusted_gmlivegpar_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/LIVEGPAR_M3_GM_Summary20260607.xlsx")
adjusted_mchsmk_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/CHSMK_M3_AA_Summary20260607.xlsx")
adjusted_gmchsmk_summaries_df <- readxl::read_xlsx("Output/FullyAdjusted/CHSMK_M3_GM_Summary20260607.xlsx")
```

```{r}
source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')
```

## FOREST PLOTS: PRIMARY LINEAR REGRESSION RESULTS (Supplemental Figures 4)

```{r, warning=FALSE}

## Define model terms to exclude for plotting
terms_to_exclude <- c("(Intercept)", "age", "sexMale", "raceethnicity_collapsedNH-Black",
                      "BEALE_latestSuburban", "BEALE_latestEx-urban",
                      "Parent_Educ<High School", "ATOTB_latest",
                      "raceethnicity_collapsedOther/Hispanic", 
                      "smoke_latestCurrent", "smoke_latestFormer", "HIBP_latestYes",
                      "DIAB_latestYes", "VIGACT_collapsed1 per week/1-3 per month", 
                      "VIGACT_collapsedNever", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")

## Age Acceleration
  ## Create filtered data for plots
filtered_df_adjusted_rural <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_mrural_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)
filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrs <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_mschlyrs_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)
filtered_df_adjusted_livegpar <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_mlivegpar_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)
filtered_df_adjusted_chsmk <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_mchsmk_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)


  ## Factor and add labels for plotting
filtered_df_adjusted_rural$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_rural$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted_rural$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_rural$outcome, levels = rev(c("GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")), labels = rev(c("GrimAge", "MPOA", "Levine", "Horvath", "Hannum")))

filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrs$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrs$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrs$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrs$outcome, levels = rev(c("GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")), labels = rev(c("GrimAge", "MPOA", "Levine", "Horvath", "Hannum")))

filtered_df_adjusted_livegpar$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_livegpar$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted_livegpar$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_livegpar$outcome, levels = rev(c("GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")), labels = rev(c("GrimAge", "MPOA", "Levine", "Horvath", "Hannum")))

filtered_df_adjusted_chsmk$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_chsmk$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted_chsmk$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_chsmk$outcome, levels = rev(c("GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")), labels = rev(c("GrimAge", "MPOA", "Levine", "Horvath", "Hannum")))



## Global Methylation
  ## Create filtered data for plots
filtered_df_adjusted_ruralGM <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_gmrural_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)
filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrsGM <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_gmschlyrs_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)
filtered_df_adjusted_livegparGM <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_gmlivegpar_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)
filtered_df_adjusted_chsmkGM <- filtered_forest_plot_data(adjusted_gmchsmk_summaries_df, terms_to_exclude)

  ## Factor and add labels for plotting
filtered_df_adjusted_ruralGM$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_ruralGM$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrsGM$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrsGM$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted_livegparGM$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_livegparGM$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))
filtered_df_adjusted_chsmkGM$exposure <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_chsmkGM$exposure, levels = c("CHSMOKE_R", "LIVEGPAR_R", "SCHLYRS_rev", "childrural_democoggen"), labels = c("Smoking during childhood", "Live with a grandparent", "Years in school", "Grew up in a rural area"))

filtered_df_adjusted_ruralGM$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_ruralGM$outcome, levels = c("Shore_mean", "Shelf_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Island_mean", "globalmethylation"), labels = c("Shore methylation", "Shelf methylation", "Open Sea methylation", "Island methylation", "Global methylation"))
filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrsGM$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrsGM$outcome, levels = c("Shore_mean", "Shelf_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Island_mean", "globalmethylation"), labels = c("Shore methylation", "Shelf methylation", "Open Sea methylation", "Island methylation", "Global methylation"))
filtered_df_adjusted_livegparGM$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_livegparGM$outcome, levels = c("Shore_mean", "Shelf_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Island_mean", "globalmethylation"), labels = c("Shore methylation", "Shelf methylation", "Open Sea methylation", "Island methylation", "Global methylation"))
filtered_df_adjusted_chsmkGM$outcome <- factor(filtered_df_adjusted_chsmkGM$outcome, levels = c("Shore_mean", "Shelf_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Island_mean", "globalmethylation"), labels = c("Shore methylation", "Shelf methylation", "Open Sea methylation", "Island methylation", "Global methylation"))


## Create One Forest Plot with All Exposures
  ## Bind rows of filtered dfs from above
combined_AA_forestplot <- bind_rows(filtered_df_adjusted_rural, filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrs, filtered_df_adjusted_livegpar, filtered_df_adjusted_chsmk)

combined_GM_forestplot <- bind_rows(filtered_df_adjusted_ruralGM, filtered_df_adjusted_schlyrsGM, filtered_df_adjusted_livegparGM, filtered_df_adjusted_chsmkGM)


## Get plot
forest_plot_AA_ALLM3 <- forest_plot(combined_AA_forestplot)
forest_plot_GM_ALLM3 <- forest_plotGM(combined_GM_forestplot)
forest_plot_AA_ALLM3
forest_plot_GM_ALLM3

## Combine plots (Supplemental Figure 3)
forest_plotcombined <- plot_grid(forest_plot_AA_ALLM3, forest_plot_GM_ALLM3, ncol = 2, align = "h", axis = "l")

## Export
save_plot("Manuscript/2026July06_supplfig3_forest_plots_m3_AA.svg", plot = forest_plot_AA_ALLM3, base_width = 18, base_height = 12)
save_plot("Manuscript/2026July06_supplfig4_forest_plots_m3_GM.svg", plot = forest_plot_GM_ALLM3, base_width = 20, base_height = 12)

save_plot("Manuscript/2026July06_supplfig3_combinedforest_plots_m3_AAGM.svg", plot = forest_plotcombined, base_width = 35, base_height = 10)


```
